claim_one_line: THE ANTI-REDISCOVERY INSTRUMENT IS ITSELF BLIND, AND ITS TWO DECLARED BLIND REGIONS ARE STALE. Asked for a brave next step, this bench proposed a no-go consolidation; it had already been written thirteen days earlier as cloud memo 152 THE_CHAIN_GAP, in answer to the owner asking the same question, and memo 152 records that it was itself the FOURTH such document because the answer was spread across three taxonomies none of which walked the chain in order. The record already names this failure class and numbers it: cloud memo 158 is a correction filed one memo after memo 157 reading BENCH ERROR #17, THE LIVE ROUTE IS NOT UNRUN, IT IS RUN AND SECTOR-COMPLETE, in which the seat asserted an unrun cell from a directory listing it never opened while writing a memo charging exactly that failure -- the least excusable of seventeen numbered instances. B1202 built an instrument against this class, scripts/checks/already_banked.py, MANDATORY before writing MISSING or OPEN, on the thesis that the register is a summary and the corpus is the record. THIS BENCH DID NOT RUN IT before two days of index work, and neither did memo 157. BUT RUNNING IT WOULD NOT HAVE BEEN ENOUGH: it scans exactly frontier/*/arc_verdict.json and frontier/*/**/FINDINGS.md IN THE WORKING TREE, so it cannot read docs/*.md -- the registers, including I-26's row saying a price is untouched and HARVEST_LEDGER's 277 SCHEDULED rows -- and cannot read the 156 SCHEDULED artifacts readable only at other commits, which is where memo 152, memo 158 and the cosmology probes live. An instrument whose thesis is read the corpus not the register cannot read the registers, and its blind spot is precisely where the rediscoveries happen; B1202 declares two blind regions but those are SUBJECT-MATTER negative controls and the search-scope gap is UNDECLARED. WORSE, THOSE TWO CONTROLS ARE NOW FALSE: they assert a MISSING claim about inflation or dark matter remains admissible, while memo 132 INFLATION_PROBE is a run certificated GREEN probe concluding the object cannot inflate with the obstruction a determinant identity, and memo 122 DM_STABILITY is a run certificated GREEN probe concluding the object's forced gauge 2-torsion supplies no stabilizer -- so the instrument built to stop the record calling something open when it is already settled declares two regions open that are already settled, the error class reproducing itself inside its own remedy. THE REPAIR: --wide added to the shared instrument, scanning both missing surfaces, with DEFAULT BEHAVIOUR UNCHANGED so B1202's reproduce.sh still prints REPRODUCES and its test still passes; the query this bench should have run before proposing a consolidation returns that consolidation as the top hit at 7 of 7 terms, and an inflation query returns memo 132 at 6 terms. Gated by tests/test_b1338_wide_already_banked.py. NOT DONE HERE AND RECORDED RATHER THAN PATCHED: B1202's negative controls are left alone because silently changing another seat's banked semantics is the wrong repair, so until its owner updates them a MISSING claim about inflation or dark matter will still be wrongly admitted; --wide is opt-in and the mandatory rule in WORKING_RULES.md is B1202's to change; and the 121 unreadable SCHEDULED rows stay invisible to every surface, which needs their branches and is a repository problem. THE ANSWER TO THE QUESTION THAT PROMPTED THIS: the circling is not mathematical and not carelessness -- the record has no mechanism for a consolidation to SUPERSEDE its predecessors, each is added rather than adopted, and the one instrument built to catch the resulting rediscovery cannot see the two places the rediscovered material is kept.
